name: fade-through
description: A calm transition primitive that fades one layer out, passes through a wash, and reveals the next layer

vars.description: Colour of the mid-transition frame. Paper resolves through --hf-fade-through-wash, accent rides --accent.
How far the wash covers at its peak. 1 is a full flash, 0.3 a light veil.
Flat fills the frame evenly, bloom concentrates the wash in the centre.
